premises.text: Mobile teams cannot get group work done with email alone when they need files, talk, and calendar
premises.evidence_span: email doesn't really cut it for us all the time

premises.text: Structured messaging stream aggregates business tools: files, polls, Dropbox/Drive, calendar, and search over long conversations
premises.evidence_span: what do we need to add to this for business tools to really get things done together as a team?

premises.text: Invites via contacts/social with deep links plus one-tap conference calling when async is not enough
premises.evidence_span: sometimes all of this back and forth is not enough. And all this asynchronous communication, which we all live and love and work with, just isn't enough

value.text: Reduce email by structuring team communication so work gets done
value.evidence_span: reducing email and moving into a much more structured way of communicating as a team
